idea-plugin.name: Status Bar Pet
idea-plugin.description:
Status Bar Pet brings a cozy, delightful, animated companion right into your JetBrains status bar. Completely silent, unobtrusive, and deeply integrated with your coding workflow, it is designed to keep you company and brighten your daily development sessions.

Meet Your Companions

  • Luna the Pixel Cat: Calm, elegant, and soft-spoken. Luna writes poetry in code, purrs on clean refactors, and rests in a warm plush bed.
  • Milo the Cyber Pup: An energetic corgi pup who bounds with joy, wags his tail at green tests, and guards his wooden doghouse.
  • Waddles the Rubber Duck: The legendary debugging master. Explain your tricky logic line by line to Waddles while enjoying the serene duck pond.
  • Pinchy the Rust Crab: The fearless concurrency champion with snappy claws, borrow-checker approval, and a rocky ocean cove.
  • Multi-Pet Squad: Pick any main companion or enable Additional Pets to display up to three pets together at the same time. Each gets its own dedicated lane and home.

Reactive to Your Real Coding Flow

  • Terminal & Editor Aware: Whenever you type in the code editor or run commands in the built-in terminal, your pets pull out their mini glowing laptops and type rhythmically with you.
  • Running & Debugging: Pets sprint into action when tasks start and attentively investigate when you launch the debugger.
  • Green Tests & Commits: Celebrates git commits (+50 XP) and green test suite runs with victory dances, confetti, and celebratory leaps.
  • Merge Conflict Alert: Spots merge conflict markers (<<<<<<<) and pulls out an investigative magnifying glass to help you review carefully.
  • Paper Ball Toss: Rapid deletions or backspacing triggers a comical paper-crumpling toss into a mini recycling bin.

A Living Companion World

  • Social Encounters: Multiple companions will wander to the edge of their movement lanes to greet, play-bow, bat paws, or celebrate with clattering pincers. When homes are off, companions can even nap together.
  • Day & Night Ambient Cycle: Late-night coding? Between 21:00 and 06:00, homes render a soft glowing crescent moon and twinkling stars.
  • Natural Life Cycles: Pets stroll, look around, twitch ears, stretch, yawn, and curl up into restful sleep with floating Zzz particles.

Leveling, Accessories & Wellness

  • Progression & Ranks: Gain XP for writing code, completing runs, and making commits. Advance from Junior Apprentice all the way to Legendary Builder.
  • Unlockable Accessories: Style your companion with party hats, developer glasses, headphones, wizard hats, halos, crowns, pirate bandanas, and viking helmets.
  • Treats & Encouragement: Feed crispy fish, juicy bones, golden breadcrumbs, or rusty gears once a minute for affection bonuses and cheerful pep talks.
  • Pomodoro & Health Reminders: Start a 25-minute focus session right from the menu, or turn on optional 45-minute posture and water break reminders.

Ultra-Lightweight & Battery Friendly

  • Optimized for 8GB RAM PCs: Engineered with zero-allocation geometric transforms, pre-instantiated stroke caches, and throttled window checks to ensure butter-smooth 60 FPS animation with zero micro-stutter.
  • Zero Background CPU Drain: Automatically slows down when the IDE is unfocused and completely halts animation when minimized, closed, or obscured.
  • 100% Silent & Non-Intrusive: No audio, no annoying popups that steal focus, and click-anywhere dismissible clean menus.

Quick Controls

  • Left or Right Click: Open the sleek quick-action menu (Feed, Cheer, Focus, Rename, Select Pets, Width, Motion).
  • Hover over Pet: Gently pet your companion with your mouse cursor to trigger floating hearts and purrs.
  • Cursor Following: Enable mouse following in the Motion menu to have your companions walk along with your cursor.
  • Custom Width: Choose Compact (72px), Comfortable (112px), or Wide (180px) to suit any status bar density.

Compatible with PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand, Rider, RustRover, Android Studio, and all other JetBrains IDEs across Dark, Light, and custom themes.

Feedback or suggestions? Contact: contact@darshan-bharat.com
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Fixed corner-stuck bug where pets would run their legs in place against the corner wall instead of sleeping.
  • Extended compatibility support to PyCharm and JetBrains IDEs 2024.2+ (build 242+).
  • Zero-allocation vector rendering engine: removed per-frame rendering hints cloning and replaced dynamic geometric allocations with shared buffers, cutting GC pressure by ~50%.

1.1.0

  • Updated default companion names to Luna, Milo, Waddles, and Pinchy.
  • Terminal awareness: typing in the built-in terminal or console now wakes up sleeping pets into active typing.
  • Major rendering efficiency: zero-allocation graphics transforms, static stroke caches, and throttled window checks for silky-smooth performance on 8GB RAM machines.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: multiple companions, individual homes, horizontal sleeping, and mouse following.
  • Clean controls, dismissible messages, no hover popups, and configurable widths.
  • Activity reactions, duck accessories, Pomodoro focus sessions, and break reminders.
